about_the_game:
Introduction to "Flying Legend"

"Flying Legend" is a highly creative casual puzzle game that takes "unscrewing bolts" as its core gameplay, leading you to embark on a 脑洞 - opening disassembly journey full of fun and challenges.

The game features a rich variety of level designs, ranging from 精巧的 mechanical devices (such as complex frame structures) to cute animal figures (such as a realistic lobster) and artistic pattern combinations. Each level uses bolts as a link to create a unique puzzle-solving scene. You need to use the "bolt removal" skill to cleverly plan the disassembly order within the specified time, remove all bolts, and completely disassemble these objects assembled by bolts.

At the same time, the game sets up multiple gameplay modes such as "Classic Mode" and "Graphic Mode", and also has auxiliary functions such as "drilling" and "undo" to help you overcome difficulties. As you progress through the levels, you can also unlock systems such as "My Shop" and open up more interesting content. Come to "Flying Legend", exercise your thinking while unscrewing bolts, and enjoy the sense of accomplishment of disassembly!
